title: The Bug That Saved Spaceflight

scenes.text: A 1969 software glitch prevented Apollo 11 from a disaster
The guidance computer overloaded when too many tasks ran, triggering a '1202' alarm
scenes.label: 1202 ALARM OVERLOAD

scenes.text: Mission control quickly decided to ignore the alarm, trusting the computer’s priority system
scenes.label: IGNORED ALARM DECISION

scenes.text: The landing proceeded safely, showing how robust real‑time software can be under pressure
scenes.label: SAFE LANDING SUCCESS

scenes.text: Follow for the future, one byte at a time.

description: Learn how a critical computer alarm turned into a triumph for Apollo 11. Follow for more famous tech bugs.
